title: Can, May, Want: 会, 能, 可以, 要
description: Three kinds of 'can' — learned skill (会), ability/possibility (能), permission (可以) — and 要 for 'want' and 'be going to'.

points.title: 会 + verb: can (learned skill)
points.summary: 会 (huì) = know how to, because you've learned it: languages, swimming, driving.
points.body:
- 我**会**游泳 (I can swim).
- 我不**会**开车 (I can't drive — never learned).

会 can also mean 'will (probably)' — later level.
examples: I can speak a little Chinese.

points.title: 能 + verb: can (able / possible now)
points.summary: 能 (néng) = physically able, or circumstances allow it right now.
points.body:
- 我今天喝酒了，不**能**开车 (I can't drive — I've been drinking).
- 你明天**能**来吗? (Can you come tomorrow?)

points.title: 可以 + verb: may (permission)
points.summary: 可以 (kěyǐ) = it's allowed. Asking permission: 可以…吗?
points.body:
- 这儿**可以**拍照吗? (Can I take photos here?)
- 不可以 = not allowed.

points.title: 要: want / be going to
points.summary: 要 (yào) + noun = want (to have); 要 + verb = want to / be going to. 要…了 = about to.
points.body:
- 我**要**一杯咖啡.
- 下个月我**要**去中国**了** (I'm going to China next month).
examples: I'd like a cup of coffee.

questions.prompt: {她|tā}（　）{游泳|yóuyǒng}，{但是|dànshì}{今天|jīntiān}{感冒|gǎnmào}{了|le}，{不|bù}{能|néng}{游|yóu}。
notes: 能 would clash with 不能 right after it — she has the skill but can't today.
questions.translation: She can swim, but she has a cold today, so she can't.

notes: 不能 = 'unable right now' (e.g. drunk) — here the reason is never having learned.
questions.translation: I've never learned, so I can't drive.

notes: 有 is negated with 没.
不会 = 'never learned' — you can drive, just not now.
不是开车 isn't grammatical here.
questions.translation: I've had alcohol today, so I can't drive.

questions.prompt:
A：{你|nǐ}{明天|míngtiān}（　）{来|lái}{吗|ma}？
B：{能|néng}，{我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{时间|shíjiān}。
notes: B answers 能 — and coming isn't a learned skill.
questions.translation: A: Can you come tomorrow? B: Yes, I have time.

notes: 会 = 'know how to' — B answers 可以.
questions.translation: A: Can I take photos here? B: Yes, you can.
Teacher, may I use your pen for a moment?
Waiter, I'd like a cup of coffee.

notes: 能…了 = 'can now' — not a plan.
questions.translation: I'm going to China next month.
